verdict.rationale: AFK's workflows are structured as directed graphs of steps where AI agents decompose goals into tasks, decide when to act autonomously vs. pause for approval, and use tools by connecting to Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, etc. (afk-docs-6, afk-docs-7, afk-docs-8, afk-docs-3). However, there is no evidence of user-facing model choice (e.g., selecting between different LLMs) for these steps, and no docs on configuring individual AI/LLM step nodes generically as in a workflow builder. Missing for 10: model selection/configuration per step, generic workflow-builder UI for adding arbitrary LLM steps, and independent corroboration beyond first-party docs.
